en.page.title: Filewise · File workspace
en.language.label: Language
en.hero.title: File workspace
en.hero.description: Add a folder once. Drop in files and let the background service take it from there.
en.stats.label: Processing overview
en.folders.title: Folders
en.folders.background: Monitoring continues after you close this page
en.jobs.title: Activity
en.filter.label: Show
en.jobs.footnote: Showing the latest 200 records. Content analysis supports UTF-8 text, Markdown, JSON and CSV; other formats get basic metadata only. Originals remain in your folder. History and metadata stay on this computer.
en.folder.name: Folder name
en.folder.root.hint: Filewise will read files in this folder. Try a practice folder first; do not select your entire home directory.
en.folder.scope.hint: Includes subfolders. Keys, tokens, databases, partial downloads and symlinks are always excluded. File scope is fixed after registration.
en.folder.existing: Also process files already in the folder
en.analysis.heading: Analysis & metadata
en.analysis.ollama: Local Ollama · an installed model is required
en.analysis.hint: Local extraction uses document titles, text excerpts, file types and configured JSON fields. It does not claim AI understanding.
en.analysis.model.placeholder: Name of a model already installed in Ollama
en.analysis.consent: When enabled, up to 20,000 characters are sent to this local service. Filewise does not upload to a remote model, download a model automatically or silently switch providers on failure. Make sure the local service itself is trusted.
en.analysis.summary: Generate a summary (an original excerpt in extraction mode)
en.analysis.fields: Extract JSON fields (one per line: name=JSON Pointer)
en.naming.heading: Naming rules
en.naming.suggest: Suggest a name · rename after my confirmation
en.naming.hint: Supports {title}, {original}, {date}, {category} and {hash}. The date is the first-detected UTC date. Extensions are preserved. Collisions get a safe suffix; existing files are never overwritten. Permissions and extended attributes are preserved; unsafe moves are refused.
en.naming.consent: I allow automatic filename changes in this folder; external links may need updating
en.detection.title: Detection settings
en.detection.hint: Stability detection is a safeguard, not proof that a download is complete. Increase the wait for slow downloads. Limits: 10 MiB per file; 1,000 files / 50 MiB per folder.
en.detail.title: Processing details
en.settings.title: Background & startup
en.settings.description: This page is just the interface. The Rust background service keeps monitoring. Closing or reopening the page does not erase your rules or history.
en.settings.autostart: Start automatically when I log in (macOS)
en.settings.autostart.hint: Changes take effect at your next login, without administrator access. Keep the executable and data directory in their current locations.
en.settings.autostart.saved: Saved for your next login. Configure again if you move the executable or data directory.
en.settings.lifecycle: This is a login item, not a crash supervisor. Scanning pauses while the computer is off or asleep, or the service is stopped. Changes made offline are detected after the service resumes.
en.login.title: Connect to local Filewise
en.login.description: Run filewise start to open an authorized workspace. Or paste the token after #token= in the link returned by that command.
en.login.hint: This token can edit registered projects, but cannot approve or publish. Do not share token-bearing links.
en.folders.empty.title: No monitored folders yet
en.folders.empty.description: Start with a practice folder and choose its analysis and naming rules.
en.jobs.basic: Basic metadata only · content extraction is not available for this format
en.jobs.empty.title: Waiting for the next file
en.jobs.empty.description: Drop files into a monitored folder. They are processed after stabilizing, without a manual sync.
en.error.field.syntax: Use name=/JSON/path for each extracted field.
en.detail.name: Title
en.detail.gate: A working save is not an approval or publication. Automation never switches the production version.
en.coverage.basic_only: Filename and type only; content was not parsed
en.coverage.model_text: Local model output; check it for accuracy
en.coverage.model_text_truncated: Local model output; input limited to the first 20,000 characters
en.error.rules_changed: Folder rules changed. Reload before saving.
en.error.overlap: This folder overlaps an existing project. Choose a separate folder.
en.error.separate: Choose a folder separate from Filewise's private database.
en.error.manual_metadata: Manual metadata is preserved. Automatic analysis will not refresh or replace it.
en.error.source_unavailable: Source access or the historical version is no longer available.
en.error.model_no_text: No text was extracted. This format cannot be analyzed by the configured rules.
en.error.rename_blocked: Project checks blocked the rename. Originals were not changed.
en.error.undo_conflict: Undo conflict. The current files were preserved.
en.error.rules_paused: Rules changed or monitoring was paused. Retry to use current rules.
en.error.scope: The proposed name is outside the configured file scope.
en.error.original_changed: The file or its declarations changed after analysis. Retry.
en.error.download: The folder changed during capture. Waiting for stability.
en.error.pick: Folder selection was cancelled or unavailable. Paste the path instead.
en.error.folder_replaced: The monitored root was replaced. Pause and inspect the folder.
en.error.model_unavailable: The local model is unavailable. Check the service and installed model.
en.error.json_field: A configured JSON field is missing, or the format does not support JSON fields.

zh-CN.page.title: Filewise · 文件工作台
zh-CN.language.label: 界面语言
zh-CN.hero.title: 文件工作台
zh-CN.hero.description: 添加一次文件夹。以后放入文件，剩下的交给后台。
zh-CN.stats.label: 处理概况
zh-CN.folders.title: 文件夹
zh-CN.jobs.title: 处理记录
zh-CN.filter.label: 显示
zh-CN.jobs.footnote: 显示最近 200 条记录。内容分析支持 UTF-8 文本、Markdown、JSON、CSV；其他格式只记录基础信息。原件留在你的文件夹中，历史与元信息保存在本机。
zh-CN.folder.name: 文件夹名称
zh-CN.folder.name.placeholder: 例如：研究资料、下载收件箱
zh-CN.folder.root.placeholder: 粘贴绝对路径，如 /Users/你/Downloads/资料
zh-CN.folder.root.hint: Filewise 会读取这个文件夹中的文件。请先用练习文件夹尝试，不要选择整个用户主目录。
zh-CN.folder.scope.hint: 范围包含子目录；密钥、令牌、数据库、临时下载文件和符号链接始终排除。文件范围在添加后固定。
zh-CN.folder.existing: 也处理文件夹中现有的文件
zh-CN.analysis.heading: 分析与元信息
zh-CN.analysis.extractive: 本地规则提取 · 不调用模型
zh-CN.analysis.ollama: 本机 Ollama · 需已有模型
zh-CN.analysis.hint: 规则提取使用文档标题、文本节选、文件类型及指定的 JSON 字段，不冒充 AI 理解。
zh-CN.analysis.model.placeholder: 填写 Ollama 中已安装的模型名
zh-CN.analysis.consent: 启用后，最多 20,000 字符文本会发送给此本机服务。Filewise 不上传到远程模型、不自动下载模型，也不在失败时偷偷切换服务。请确认该本机服务自身可信。
zh-CN.analysis.summary: 生成内容摘要（规则模式为原文节选）
zh-CN.analysis.fields: 提取 JSON 字段（每行一个：字段名=JSON Pointer）
zh-CN.naming.heading: 命名规则
zh-CN.naming.keep: 保留原名 · 只添加元信息
zh-CN.naming.suggest: 建议新名称 · 我确认后才改名
zh-CN.naming.auto: 自动改名 · 可在记录中撤销
zh-CN.naming.hint: 支持 {title}、{original}、{date}、{category}、{hash}；日期为首次检测的 UTC 日期，扩展名自动保留。重名时追加安全后缀，不覆盖现有文件。保留权限和扩展属性，无法安全移动则拒绝。
zh-CN.naming.consent: 我同意自动修改此文件夹中的文件名；外部链接可能需要更新
zh-CN.detection.title: 检测设置
zh-CN.detection.hint: 稳定检测是保护措施，不是下载完成证明。慢速下载可调大等待时间；单文件 ≤10 MiB，每文件夹 ≤1,000 文件 / 50 MiB。
zh-CN.detail.title: 处理详情
zh-CN.settings.title: 后台与启动
zh-CN.settings.description: 网页只是操作界面，Rust 后台服务负责持续监控。退出网页、重新打开，都不会清空配置与记录。
zh-CN.settings.autostart.hint: 更改从下次登录生效，不需要管理员权限。请保留程序和数据目录的位置。
zh-CN.settings.autostart.saved: 已保存，从下次登录生效。程序路径或数据目录变化后请重新设置。
zh-CN.settings.lifecycle: 这是登录启动项，不是崩溃自动拉起服务；电脑关机、休眠或服务停止期间不会扫描。恢复运行后会检测离线期间的文件变化。
zh-CN.login.title: 连接本机 Filewise
zh-CN.login.description: 运行 filewise start 会打开已授权的工作台。也可粘贴该次启动返回链接中 #token= 后面的令牌。
zh-CN.login.hint: 令牌可编辑已登记项目，但不能审批或发布。不要分享带令牌的链接。
zh-CN.folders.empty.title: 还没有监控文件夹
zh-CN.folders.empty.description: 从一个练习文件夹开始，选择分析方式与命名规则。
zh-CN.jobs.basic: 仅基础信息 · 此格式暂无内容解析
zh-CN.jobs.empty.title: 等待下一份文件
zh-CN.jobs.empty.description: 把文件放入已监控的文件夹，稳定后会自动处理；无需手动同步。
zh-CN.error.field.syntax: 提取字段请填写：字段名=/JSON路径
zh-CN.detail.name: 标题
zh-CN.detail.gate: 工作区保存不等于审批或发布；当前生产版本不会被自动切换。
zh-CN.coverage.basic_only: 仅文件类型与名称；未解析正文
zh-CN.coverage.extractive_text: 本地原文节选 / 规则提取
zh-CN.coverage.model_text: 本机模型生成，需自行核对
zh-CN.coverage.model_text_truncated: 本机模型生成，正文截取前 20,000 字符
zh-CN.error.rules_changed: 文件夹规则已变化，请重新载入后保存。
zh-CN.error.overlap: 此文件夹与已登记项目重叠，请选择独立的文件夹。
zh-CN.error.separate: 请选择与 Filewise 私有数据库分开的文件夹。
zh-CN.error.manual_metadata: 人工元信息已保留，自动分析不会刷新或替换这些声明。
zh-CN.error.source_unavailable: 来源权限或历史版本已不可用。
zh-CN.error.model_no_text: 未提取到正文，此格式无法按当前规则分析。
zh-CN.error.rename_blocked: 项目检查阻止了改名，原件未改变。
zh-CN.error.undo_conflict: 撤销发生冲突，已保留当前文件。
zh-CN.error.rules_paused: 规则已变化或监控已暂停，请重试以使用当前规则。
zh-CN.error.scope: 建议名称超出了配置的文件范围。
zh-CN.error.original_changed: 分析后文件或声明发生了变化，请重新处理。
zh-CN.error.download: 采集期间文件夹发生变化，正在等待内容稳定。
zh-CN.error.resume: 请先恢复监控，再重新处理。
zh-CN.error.pick: 文件夹选择已取消或不可用，也可以直接粘贴路径。
zh-CN.error.folder_replaced: 监控根目录已被替换，请暂停并检查文件夹。
zh-CN.error.model_unavailable: 本机模型不可用，请检查服务和已安装的模型。
zh-CN.error.json_field: 指定的 JSON 字段缺失，或当前文件格式不支持提取 JSON 字段。
